_comment: Chapter V room by room, in play order (docs/CHAPTER5.md §1). A room whose painting has arrived has its row in tools/rooms/painted_rooms.py and its scene; the rest wait for theirs (docs/CHAPTER5_ART.md). validate_data.gd checks every id named here exists in the merged game + drafts.

rooms.note: Ahithophel under his fig tree, the cut ropes at its foot. The first choice of the chapter.
The vineyard wall; the gardeners still tend the vines.
Vertical, four terraces. The vintner's book on the top one.
Tirzah by the white basin under the fall (the rest point); two feasters wait. Fork after: orchard / arbor.
Under the trees: the most fruit and the most locusts. No story here.
Along the vine gallery in two tiers: little fruit, gardeners and smoke. No story here.
The feast without end: six feasters wait at the table; the swollen two and the rider hold the door.
The boundary stone (the rest point); the Voice speaks. Fork after: hives / press.
Combs of the locusts in the rock, pools of honey, thicker swarms (swarm_per_surfeit 1.0). No story here.
The press and its vat of wine: a close fight on the ground. No story here.
Vertical, down the shaft of the pit. The key page in a niche.
Abaddon over the fire; the key in the finale.
